question: Which view in MS PowerPoint is useful for editing or formatting a single slide at a time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Normal view**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Normal view** in MS PowerPoint is particularly useful for editing or formatting a single slide at a time.
 
• This view displays the slide in the main window, allowing for detailed adjustments to text, images, and other elements.</l
